target: The Void Storm Zone IV in the Dimmr Deep. Inside, the remnants of all things are warped into refracted echoes of Voidmatter, re-emerging into this world...

source: A central do Sentinela, escondida entre pedras gigantes no Vale da Glória.
target: The Sentinel's Hub, hidden among giant stones in the Vale of Glory.

source: A conversa animada esvaneceu-se, restando apenas o suave embalo da maré como companhia.
target: The lively chatter has faded, leaving only the gentle lull of the tide as company.

source: A cúpula está despedaçada, e a pouca luz que resta ilumina ruínas cobertas pela vegetação. Entre ervas daninhas densas, a Propulsão do Reator moribunda se agarra a uma mera lembrança de quando foi o sol.
target: The dome is shattered, and what light remains illuminates overgrown ruins. Amidst thick weeds, the dying Reactor Drive holds onto a mere memory that it once was the sun.

source: A entrada para o subsolo onde quantidades colossais de energia estão sendo armazenadas. Explore para desvendar segredos conhecidos por poucos.
target: The entrance to the underground where colossal amounts of energy are being stored. Explore to discover secrets known by few.

source: A esperança não se encontra na primavera, mas no inverno profundo, quando a vida começa a brotar pela primeira vez.
target: Hope is not found in spring, but in deep winter, when life first begins to sprout.

source: A filial da Fortaleza de Xuanfang do renomado restaurante "Sabores de Yuan". A proprietária do local é Donzela do Filé.
target: The Xuanfang Hold branch of the renowned restaurant "Yuan's Flavors." The owner of the place is the Fillet Fairmaiden.

source: A lenda conta sobre a descida do Sentinela Imperator neste local, desaparecendo nas nuvens. Agora, outra presença reivindica domínio sobre este lugar…
target: Legend tells of Sentinel Imperator's descent upon this site, vanishing into the clouds. Now, another presence claims dominion over this place...

source: A lenda fala deste santuário escondido construído à mão por Hsin, a Raposa Lunar, onde águas azuis, lanternas ao luar, árvores verdes exuberantes e elegantes pavilhões complementam-se em perfeita harmonia.
target: Legend tells of this hidden sanctuary hand-built by Hsin the Moon Fox, where azure waters, moonlit lanterns, lush green trees, and elegant pavilions complement one another in perfect harmony.

source: A localização do misterioso Rei Peixe, conforme mostrado no mapa do tesouro. Este peixe extremamente raro parece possuir um poder muito além do de formas de vida aquáticas comuns.
target: The location of the mysterious Fish King, as shown on the treasure map. This extremely rare fish seems to possess a power far beyond that of ordinary aquatic lifeforms.

source: A luz da manhã brilha sobre as árvores gêmeas, enquanto uma cachoeira oculta o grande palácio.
target: The morning light shines on the twin trees, while a waterfall conceals the grand palace.

source: A luz tremeluzente dançando no topo da torre de refinação se assemelha ao coração pulsante de um tigre.
target: As the flickering light dances atop the refining tower, it resembles the pulsing heart of a tiger.

source:
A medida que exploras Solaris, paisajes memorables te esperan en cada esquina.
Busca puntos de vista cerca de estos paisajes para inmortalizar esos momentos preciosos.
target:
As you explore Solaris, memorable sceneries await at every turn.
Look for Viewpoints near these landscapes to immortalize these precious moments.

source: A medida que la luz parpadeante danza en la cima de la torre de refinado, se asemeja al latido de un tigre.
target: As the flickering light dances atop the refining tower, it resembles the pulsing heart of a tiger.

source: A mãe de Misha está ausente há um bom tempo. Ela pode estar precisando de ajuda...
target: Misha's mother has been away for quite a while. She may need some help...

source: A nova temporada da Corrida Tochestrela está oficialmente em andamento! Prepare-se para emoções na pista, multidões vibrantes e prêmios atraentes! Suba na sua moto favorita e inscreva-se na corrida agora mesmo!
target: The new Startorch Racing Season is officially underway! Give it up for on-track thrills, roaring crowds, and enticing prizes! Hop on your beloved motorbike and sign up for the race now!

source: A plataforma de Síntese da Academia permite que os ressonantes criem poções, construam materiais e purifiquem substâncias com facilidade.
target: The Academy's Synthesis platform allows Resonators to create potions, construct materials, and purify substances with ease.

source:
A plataforma de síntese da cidade de Ragunna permite que os ressonantes criem poções, construam materiais e purifiquem substâncias com facilidade.
Prepare-se: o palco agora pertence à reação de combinação.
target:
The Ragunna City's Synthesis platform allows Resonators to create potions, construct materials, and purify substances with ease.
Be hold—the stage now belongs to the combination reaction.

source:
A professora Festa acredita ter encontrado o algoritmo perfeito para duelos, um que a tornaria invencível em qualquer cenário. No entanto, sempre há variáveis que os algoritmos não conseguem prever.

Características da Duelista: nenhuma
target:
Professor Festa believes she has found the perfect algorithm for dueling—one that would make her undefeated under any scenario. However, there are always variables that algorithms cannot predict.

Duelist Traits: None

source: A rede de rotas de Lahai-Roi, junto com o Observatório do Coletivo da Jornada Espacial que costumava monitorar e registrar seu terreno, ecossistema e clima, foi devastada por uma Tempestade do Vazio. É hora de reconstruir tudo!
target: Lahai-Roi's route network, along with the Spacetrek Observatory that used to monitor and record its terrain, ecosystem, and climate, has been devastated by a Void Storm. It's time to rebuild them all!

source: A tramos oculto entre montañas o bajo tierra, este camino se construyó para facilitar el transporte y conectar personas.
target: A route built through mountains or underground to facilitate transport and connect people.

source: A través del Observatorio Intergaláctico, emite señales de control y ajusta el Sistema de Proyección Celestial para generar clima simulado en Lahai-Roi.
target: Use the Spacetrek Observatory to broadcast control signals, adjusting the Sky Projection Array to generate simulated weather across Lahai-Roi.

source: A Árvore Anciã Ruína do Vazio na Fissura Selada está protegida pelo Poder de Ressonância da Hiyuki. Embora não esteja severamente contaminada por Matéria do Vazio, a árvore está congelada sob gelo espesso.
target: The Voidbane Eldertree in the Sealed Fissure is protected by Hiyuki's Resonance Ability. Though not severely contaminated by Voidmatter, the tree is frozen under thick ice.

source: A Árvore Anciã Ruína do Vazio nas Profundezas de Dimmr fica bem no local da batalha decisiva. Como resultado, o sistema radicular da árvore está soterrado sob os escombros.
target: The Voidbane Eldertree in the Dimmr Deep sits right at the site of the decisive battle. As a result, the tree's root system is buried under rubble.

source: A Árvore Anciã Ruína do Vazio no Penhasco Silencioso está cercada por Exoenxames furiosos. Fazer o levantamento aqui não será fácil.
target: The Voidbane Eldertree in the Silent Crag is surrounded by rampaging Exoswarm. Surveying here won't be easy.

source: A Árvore Anciã Ruína do Vazio no Pouso de Solisia está severamente contaminada por Matéria do Vazio. Felizmente, componentes de Exotitã espalhados pela área podem ser usados para ajudar a restaurá-la.
target: The Voidbane Eldertree in Solisia Landing is severely contaminated by Voidmatter. Fortunately, Exostrider components scattered across the area can be used to help restore it.

source: A Última Simulação de Blocos Marciais
A água da piscina profunda parece se aglutinar quando uma entrada para o antro se abre.
target: The water of the deep pool seems to condense as an entrance to the hollows opens.

source: Abby, die Natur verlangt keine Entscheidungen in ihrem Namen.

source: Abby, la nature ne veut pas qu'on décide à sa place.
target: "Abby, nature asks for no decisions made in its place."

target: You've agreed to learn the guqin from Qingxiao. Head to her training hall to begin the next stage of your lessons.

source: Acima dos penhascos imponentes que alcançam o céu, um verdadeiro dragão emerge das nuvens.

target: Venture to the Mirror Lake in the grove to uncover the legendary knights' traces and retrieve the five lost swords. Stay until the sun sets and the moon rises.

source: Agradable camino junto a los Humedales de Turborayas, apreciado tanto por los royas como por los estudiantes de la Academia Fuegostelar por su paisaje inolvidable.
target: A level road tracing the Jetray Marsh, beloved by both the Roya tribe and the students of Startorch Academy for its unforgettable scenery.

source: Ain foi encarregado de guardar os suprimentos extras da equipe de filmagem, mas eles de alguma forma sofreram danos graves...
target: Ain was tasked with guarding the film crew's spare supplies, but they have somehow sustained severe damage...

target: Ain was tasked with guarding the film crew's spare supplies, but they have somehow sustained severe damage...

target: Ain was tasked with guarding the film crew's spare supplies, but they have somehow sustained severe damage...

target: Adjust the blocks to a single color to restore the scenery to its former glory.

target: At dawn, there are always people who confuse the mirage for the ascending sun.

target: At the edge of Mt. Firmament, whispers of tides echo from the seaside ruins.

Algunos Solistirpes vagan por la Superficie del Páramo Helado tras perder a sus pastores…
Encuentra los Solistirpes perdidos y entrega las Solisemillas que has recolectado al Gran Solistirpe en la Cámara Vital Upphaf.
target:
Some Soliskin, having lost their Shepherd's guidance, now wander the Frostlands Surface.
Seek out these lost Soliskin and bring the Soliseeds you gather to the Giant Soliskin in the Upphaf Life Chamber.

Algunos Solistirpes vagan por las Llanuras Dimmr tras perder a sus pastores…

target: Some Soliskin, having lost their Shepherd's guidance, now wander the Dimmr Plains. Seek out these lost Soliskin and bring the Soliseeds you gather to the Giant Soliskin in Solisia Landing.

Algunos enemigos que no han sido capturados por la Jaula Censora siguen vagando por las zonas salvajes…
Elimínalos y devuelve la paz a la tierra de Xuanfang.
target:
Enenmies left uncontained by the Censure Cages continue to roam the wild...
Purge these threats to restore peace to the Land of Xuanfang.

Alguns Solispíritos, tendo perdido a orientação de seu Pastor, agora vagam pela Superfície das Terras Geladas.

target:

target: Some Soliskin, having lost their Shepherd's guidance, now wander the Dimmr Plains. Seek out these lost Soliskin and bring the Soliseeds you gather to the Giant Soliskin in Solisia Landing.

target: Part of the Resonance ecological information network, Resonance Beacons collect field data in a small radius and transmit it back to the Resonance Nexus.

Als Zahira das Spiel von der Akademie zu den Roya brachte, hätte sie nie gedacht, dass sich Spitze des Ruhms im Bjartr-Wald wie ein Lauffeuer verbreiten würde.

source: Dans une vallée érodée par la Marée noire, un vieux gladiateur attend son destin, tel une arme rouillée rêvant du passé.
target: In a valley scarred by the Dark Tide, an old Gladiator silently awaits his destiny. Like an ancient, rusted sword, he dreams of past glories.

source: Danse du Garde-fonte, la fortune se montre
Das Drehbuch des Erzählers: Der außergewöhnliche „Sohn der Unnachgiebigen Tugend“: Teil Zwei
target: Storyteller's Script: "The Extraordinary 'Hermit of Unyielding Virtue'" (II)

source: Das Drehbuch des Geschichtenerzählers: Der außergewöhnliche „Sohn der Unnachgiebigen Tugend“: Teil Eins
target: Storyteller's Script: "The Extraordinary 'Hermit of Unyielding Virtue'" (I)

source: Das Filmteam der Pioneer Association dreht Filmmaterial für eine Dokumentation und benötigt deine Hilfe.
target: A film crew from the Pioneer Association is currently gathering footage for a documentary, and they need your assistance.

source: Das Geschäft von KU-Money, einem der Robot-Manager der Schwarzen Küsten, bietet exklusive, hochqualitative Services für die Mitglieder der Schwarzen Küsten an und schafft zudem weltweit Wohlstand für die Schwarzen Küsten.
target: An exchange run by KU-Money, one of the Black Shores' administrator droids. It offers high-quality services to Black Shores members and also helps to build the organization's wealth from around the world.

source: Das Getümmel und das Lachen haben sich verstreut, nur das Geräusch der Flut bleibt.
target: The lively chatter has faded, leaving only the gentle lull of the tide as company.

source: Das Heliogyr, von Leerenmaterie korrumpiert, wird zu einem verzerrten Kern der Energie, der eine Katastrophe des Lichts entfesselt. Wo Licht berührt, werden Menschen und Exoschwarm zu Nichts reduziert, als hätten sie nie existiert.
target: The Heliogyre, corrupted by Voidmatter, becomes a twisted core of energy that unleashes a calamity of "light." Where light touches, people and Exoswarm are reduced to nothingness, as if they had never existed.

source: Das Herz von Das Himmelswerk, nun Heimat der Myriadenfalle: Zerbrochenes Gerüst. Die abgelegene Plattform hat nichts von ihrer einstigen Majestät bewahrt.
target: The heart of the Skyworks, now home to the Myriad Snare: Rustfire Chassis. The isolated platform retains none of its former majesty.

source: Das Hub des Hütenden, verborgen zwischen riesigen Felsen im Tal des Ruhms.
target: The Sentinel's Hub, hidden among giant stones in the Vale of Glory.

source: Das Incinero-Blütenblatt welkt allmählich und die Flamme am Himmel verblasst ebenfalls.
target: The Incinero Petals wilt slowly, mirroring the fading flame in the sky.

source: Das Kamera-Echo der Pioneer Association in Ragunna. Es erledigt seine Arbeit mit der Eleganz eines kultivierten Kavaliers und pausiert zwischen jeder Aufnahme für einen entspannenden Schluck Entwicklerflüssigkeit.
target: C-MOSS, the camera Echo owned by the Pioneer Association's Ragunna branch, acts with all the fine manners of an old gentleman. He captures moments in time with care, often sipping a cup of developer solution between shots.

source: Das Layout der Modellbox entspricht der gesamten Kammer. Bewege den leuchtenden Gegenstand in die angegebene Richtung, um die Position der Mechanismen in der Modellbox zu ändern und die Umgebung der gesamten Kammer zu verändern.
target: The Model Box's layout mirrors the entire chamber. Move the glowing objects in the indicated direction to shift the Model Box's internal mechanisms, thereby altering the layout of the entire Chamber.

source: Das Lied von Eis und Stahl
target: The Song of Ice and Steel

source:
Das Manuskript eines Geschichtenerzählers, das die wichtigsten historischen Ereignisse der Region Jinzhou in Huanglong wiedergibt.

...
target:
A storyteller's script based on historical events, recounting the history of the Jinzhou region in Huanglong.

...

source: Das Morgenlicht scheint auf die Zwillingsbäume, während ein Wasserfall den prächtigen Palast verbirgt.
target: The morning light shines on the twin trees, while a waterfall conceals the grand palace.

source: Das Nachglühen verzaubert den Bergpass, während schwebende Felsen an das Himmelsportal klopfen.
target: The afterglow graces the mountain pass, while floating rocks knock on heaven's gate.

source:
Das Puppentheater zeigt traditionelle Dramen, die mit Marionetten aufgeführt werden, eine heute in Jinzhou sehr beliebte Unterhaltungsquelle.
Baue oder verbessere diesen Stand, um die Beliebtheit deutlich zu steigern.
target:
The Puppet Theater features traditional dramas performed with marionettes, now a beloved source of entertainment in Jinzhou.
Build or Upgrade this stall to significantly boost Popularity.

source: Das Schlachtfeld, auf dem der Exoschreiter einst Aleph-1 gegenübertrat – heute ein Friedhof begrabener Exoschreiter-Komponenten. Vom Zahn der Zeit verwittert ist dieser Ort nun bekannt als Rostender Hügel.
target: The battlefield where the Exostrider once confronted Aleph-1. It is now a graveyard of buried Exostrider components. Weathered by time, it has come to be known as Rustbound Hillside.

source: Das Testserver-Trainingsgelände bietet drei verschiedene Kampftrainingsumgebungen.
target: The Test Server Training Ground provides three different combat traning environments.

source: Das Verkehrsnetz von Lahai-Roi sowie das Spacetrek-Observatorium, das einst Gelände, Ökosystem und Klima überwachte, wurden von einem Leerensturm verwüstet. Es ist an der Zeit, alles wieder aufzubauen.
target: Lahai-Roi's route network, along with the Spacetrek Observatory that used to monitor and record its terrain, ecosystem, and climate, has been devastated by a Void Storm. It's time to rebuild them all!

source: Das Versteck des Korrosaurus, wo viele tapfere Krieger ihr Ende fanden.
target: The lair of Corrosaurus, where many brave warriors embraced their end.

source: Das Versunkene Gewölbe wurde ursprünglich als Gefängnis errichtet, um TDs zu beherbergen, doch nun hallen menschliche Stimmen aus seinen tiefsten Tiefen wider ...
target: The Sunken Warren was originally built as a prison to contain Tds, yet human voices are now echoing from its deepest| depths...

source: Das Wasser des tiefen Beckens scheint sich zu verdichten, als sich ein Eingang zu den Hohlräumen öffnet.
target: The water of the deep pool seems to condense as an entrance to the hollows opens.

source: Das alte Wohnheim der Sternenfackel-Akademie, das von Leerenstürmen verschlungen wurde. Die leblosen Strukturen verbleiben als ewiges Zeugnis.
target: Startorch Academy's old dormitory swallowed whole by Void Storms. The structures remain, forever lifeless.

source: Das angesagteste Restaurant in der Stadt Septimont. Gönn dir ein Ruhmesmahl, trink einen frischen Weizensaft oder tanze zur Übertragung des Agon mit! Bei Solis gibt es immer einen Platz für dich.
target: The hottest restaurant in Septimont City. Here, you can order a hearty Glory Set, sip on a glass of wheat juice, or even get up and dance while watching a match broadcast. At Solis, there's always a place for you.

source: Das experimentelle Projekt der Huaxu-Akademie bietet großzügige Belohnungen. Erobere die Herausforderungen des Turms für großartige Preise.
target: The Huaxu Academy's experimental project offers generous rewards. Conquer the tower's challenges for great prizes.

source: Das flackernde Licht des Raffinierturms ist wie das schlagende Herz des Tigerschlunds.
target: As the flickering light dances atop the refining tower, it resembles the pulsing heart of a tiger.

source: Das vom Gremium der Savantae hinterlassene imitierendes Klanggerät kann mächtige Feinde simulieren. Der in diesem Kampf erhaltene Datensatz kann im Simulationstrainingsladen gegen verschiedene Belohnungen eingetauscht werden.
target: The Imitative Sonic Device left by the Court of Savantae can simulate powerful enemies. The Data Set obtained in this battle can be exchanged for various rewards in the Simulation Training Store.

source: Das vom Hof des Savantae-Komitees hinterlassene imitative Schallgerät kann mächtige Feinde simulieren. Der in diesem Kampf erhaltene Datensatz kann im Simulationstrainingsladen gegen verschiedene Belohnungen eingetauscht werden.
target: The Imitative Sonic Device left by the Court of Savantae can simulate powerful enemies. The Data Set obtained in this battle can be exchanged for various rewards in the Simulation Training Store.

source: Date un respiro en los Baños Termales y disfruta de un instante de calma.
target: Why not take a break and unwind at the Thermes Baths? Let the warmth soothe your body, and savor a moment of leisure…

source: De acordo com os anciãos da Vila Arco-Íris, a paisagem enigmática, semelhante aos ossos de dragões, guarda uma conexão profunda com Jué.
target: As per the elders of Hongzhen, the enigmatic landscape, resembling the bones of dragons, holds a profound connection to Jué.

source: Decole e atravesse vastas distâncias a partir daqui.
target: Take off and traverse vast distances from here.

source: Denk daran, mein Schatz, Kostüme und Masken sind nur prächtige Fassaden. Unter ihrer Eleganz und Schönheit verbergen sich nicht verfeinerte Damen und Herren, sondern verführerische und tödliche Gefahren.
target: Remember, darling, that costumes and masks are mere florid facades. Beneath their elegance and beauty lie not refined ladies and gentlemen, but seductive and deadly perils.

source: Dentro da Terra de Xuanfang, existem Baús de Suprimentos ocupados e Heranças das Marés. Derrote os inimigos que os cercam e reivindique as riquezas que eles armazenam.
target: Throughout the Land of Xuanfang lie occupied Supply Chests and Tidal Heritages. Defeat the enemies surrounding them to claim the riches within.

source:
Depuis quand est-elle ici ?
Elle n'en a aucune idée.
Combien de temps restera-t-elle ?
Tant que cet « ici » existe.
target:
Since when has she been here?
No one knows.
How long will she stay?
Until "here" ceases to exist.

Depósito de Metais Preciosos e Obras de Arte - 1º Andar

source: Depósito de arte y metales preciosos

Der Albatrossa wartet auf deine Ankunft.
Genieße eine grandiose Reise durch die Lüfte, gemeinsam mit dem Albatrossa.
target:
A Wingray awaits you here.
Join the Wingray on an exhilarating panoramic aerial tour.

source: Der Berg Firmament beheimatet eine besondere heiße Quelle namens Sagaci-Quellen.
target: Mt. Firmament is home to a special hot spring called Sagaci Springs.

source: Der Eroberer des Ruhms, Furius, erwartet hier. Kämpfe für den Sieg und den Ruhm in diesem epischen Duell!
target: The Conqueror of Prestige, Furius, waits here. Claim both victory and glory in this epic duel.

source: Der Großkommandant hat in den von ihm patrouillierten Gebieten besondere Belohnungen für dich hinterlassen. Schnapp dir deinen Sensor und die Adleraugen-Drohne – es ist Zeit, sie aufzuspüren.
target: The Grand Commander has left some special rewards for you out in the territories they patrol. Grab your Sensor and Owlwatch Scanner. It's time to track them down.

source: Der Hafen mit dem größten Seefrüchte-Umschlag in der Inselgruppe. Hier kann man auslaufen und Handel treiben.
target: The island port with the largest throughput of marine products. You can set out to sea and trade here.

source: Der Hardcore-Gamer Songdis schlägt ein Retro-Spielmusikprojekt vor und sucht nach Mitwirkenden …
target: The hard-core gamer Songdis proposes a retro game music project and is looking for collaborators…

source:
Der Herrscher des Autómata-Reichs.
Hilf Auto-Königin, das Reich zurückzuerobern und wiederauferstehen zu lassen, und du wirst reich belohnt.
target:
The ruler of the Automaton Empire.
Help King Auto reclaim and resurrect the empire, and you shall be handsomely rewarded.

source: Der Jagdplatz Agrippas, des „Eisens“, eine der Koryphäen des Ruhms.
target: The haunting grounds of a Lord of Glory, Raul the Dustbound.

source: Der Jagdplatz Gallus', des „Albtraums“, eine der Koryphäen des Ruhms.
target: The haunting grounds of a Lord of Glory, Gallus the Nightmare.

source: Der Jagdplatz Lilianias, des „Glanzes“, eine der Koryphäen des Ruhms.
target: The haunting grounds of a Lord of Glory, Liliania the Splendent.

source: Der Jagdplatz Marcias, des „Taus“, eine der Koryphäen des Ruhms.
target: The haunting grounds of a Lord of Glory, Marcia the Lifespring.

source: Der Jagdplatz Rauls, des „Staubs“, eine der Koryphäen des Ruhms.
target: The haunting grounds of a Lord of Glory, Raul the Dustbound.

source: Der Kodex der Tiefe: Philosophie des Ordens I
target: Codex of the Deep: Order Philosophy I

source: Der Kodex der Tiefe: Philosophie des Ordens II
target: Codex of the Deep: Order Philosophy II

source: Der Leerenbefallene Uralte Baum im Sonnenuntergangsdamm ist stark von Leerenmaterie befallen. Zum Glück können über das Gebiet verteilte Exoschreiter-Komponenten helfen, ihn wieder zu bereinigen.
target: The Voidbane Eldertree in Solisia Landing is severely contaminated by Voidmatter. Fortunately, Exostrider components scattered across the area can be used to help restore it.

source: Der Leerenbefallene Uralte Baum in der Dimmr-Tiefe ragt am Schauplatz einer entscheidenden Schlacht empor. Deshalb sind die Wurzeln des Baums unter Schutt begraben.
target: The Voidbane Eldertree in the Dimmr Deep sits right at the site of the decisive battle. As a result, the tree's root system is buried under rubble.

source: Der Leerenbefallene Uralte Baum in der Stillen Felsklippe ist umgeben von wütenden Exoschwärmen. Das wird keine einfache Expedition.
target: The Voidbane Eldertree in the Silent Crag is surrounded by rampaging Exoswarm. Surveying here won't be easy.

source: Der Leerenbefallene Uralte Baum in der Versiegelungsstätte wird von Hiyukis Resonanzkraft beschützt. Obwohl er nicht stark von Leerenmaterie befallen ist, ist der Baum von einer dicken Eisschicht umhüllt.
target: The Voidbane Eldertree in the Sealed Fissure is protected by Hiyuki's Resonance Ability. Though not severely contaminated by Voidmatter, the tree is frozen under thick ice.

source: Der Legende nach stieg das Hütende Imperator an diesem Ort herab und verschwand in den Wolken. Nun beansprucht eine andere Präsenz die Herrschaft über diesen Ort...
target: Legend tells of Sentinel Imperator's descent upon this site, vanishing into the clouds. Now, another presence claims dominion over this place...

source:
Der Legende zufolge ist das Schicksal der Nachkommen der Familie Fisalia eng mit den drei hohen Türmen verknüpft, und dies ist einer davon.
Wohin treiben die Fische? Hinauf zur Spitze des Turms, zum hohen, stillen Nachthimmel.
target:
Legend has it that, the fate of the descendants of Fisalia is deeply intertwined with the Thorncrown Rises—this tower is one among them.
Where do the schools of fish swim? Over the towers, into the silent night sky above...

source:
Der Lichtformer ist eine lichtempfindliche Datenspeicherkomponente des Exoschreiters, die von Solisling-Energie angetrieben werden kann.
Passe die Projektion der korrekten Form an, um das Gerät zu aktivieren.
target: A Light Builder is a light-sensitive data storage component of the Exostrider that can be powered by Soliskin energy. Adjust its projection to the correct shape to activate the device.

source: Der Overdash-Club hat diese Overdash-Strecke hier aufgebaut. Scheint es, dass es auch Strecken an anderen Orten gibt?
target: The Overdash Club set up this Overdashing track here. It seems there are tracks in other places too?

source: Der Schatten des Turms: Turm der Dämmerung
target: Shadow of the Towers: Twilight Rise

source: Der Schatten des Turms: Turm des Widerhalls
target: Shadow of the Towers: Resounding Rise

source: Der Schatzdetektor hilft den Nutzern, nahegelegene, noch unentdeckte Versorgungstruhen schnell zu finden, indem er ihre Signalfrequenz erkennt. Es ist ein unverzichtbares Werkzeug für das Überleben in der freien Natur.
target: The Lootmapper identifies specific frequencies to quickly locate nearby undiscovered Supply Chests. It is an indispensable tool to facilitate exploration in the wilds.

source: Der Uralte Baum kann wiederhergestellt werden
target: More Voidbane Eldertrees can be restored

source: Der Wind streift über die Federn, nur beantwortet von einer Reihe von Schnarchen.
target: "Wind brushes the feathers, answered only by a string of snores."

source: Der gute Regen bittet die Gäste zu bleiben, doch die Geister der alten Zeiten kehren im Nebel zurück.
target: Gentle rain beckons visitors to linger, lamenting phantoms from days gone by.

source: Der neue Unterrichtsort ist auf den Westlichen Fang-Gipfeln. Begib dich zur vereinbarten Zeit dorthin, um Qingxiao zu treffen.
target: The new lesson site is the Western Fang Peaks. When the appointed time comes, go there to meet Qingxiao.

source: Der von Fisalia und dem Orden entwickelte Terminal ermöglicht die Simulation mächtiger Gegner. Die im Kampf gewonnenen Prüfungsmünzen können im Prüfungsladen gegen wertvolle Belohnungen eingetauscht werden.
target: A special Terminal developed by the Fisalias and the Order, capable of simulating powerful enemies. The Trial Coin obtained in this battle can be exchanged for various rewards in the Trial Store.

source: Der wissenschaftliche Zwischenbericht zu Lahai-Roi P.C.–LH–R/0987
Der wissenschaftliche Zwischenbericht zu Lahai-Roi P.C.–LH–R/0987

Dernière joute de la cour carrée

target: Defeat the envoys guarding the area to end this pointless trial…

source: Des ailes au cœur de l'hiver
Des camarades devenus ennemis, se montrant leurs crocs même dans le rêve.
target: "Comrades turned enemies, baring their fangs at each other even in the dream."

source: Des documents de l'Observatoire Trek-spatial, éparpillés à travers la terre pour des raisons inconnues.
target: Files from the Spacetrek Observatory, scattered across the land for unknown reasons.

source: Des murs invisibles pour les ennemis de Huanglong National Geographic
target: Invisible Walls for enemies in Huanglong National Geographic

source: Des paysages familiers sont dépouillés des couleurs qu'ils avaient autrefois. Un livre de coloriage attend votre touche pour redonner vie à ses teintes.
target: Familiar scenes now lie faded, stripped of the colors they once held. A picture book awaits your touch to bring its hues back to life.

source: Des pistes de défis Moby-Nuage sur mesure sont disséminés dans les Terres de Xuanfang. Traversez les cercles et cumulez des points pour relever les défis et remporter vos récompenses.
target: Scattered throughout the Land of Xuanfang are customized Cloud Ride challenge courses. Cross Score Rings to complete the challenges and claim your rewards.

source:
Desafie Jonna! Deixe-a ver quem é o verdadeiro Duelista!

Características da Duelista: cada vez que a duelista mobilizar um Eco, o Eco ganhará Resiliência.
target:
Challenge Jonna! Let her see who's the real Duelist!

Duelist Traits: Each time the duelist deploys an Echo, the Echo gains Resilience.

source:
Desde el velo de la oscuridad, da un paso hacia el resplandor de la libertad.
Ahora va a toda velocidad. Nunca permitirá que su mundo vuelva a perder el color.
target:
From the shroud of darkness, she steps into the brilliance of freedom.
Full throttle now. She will never let her world be drained of color again.

source:
Desde quando ela está aqui?
Ninguém sabe.
Por quanto tempo ela vai ficar?
Até que "aqui" deixe de existir.
target:
Since when has she been here?
No one knows.
How long will she stay?
Until "here" ceases to exist.

source: Desta vez, a lição mudou para o Bosque Yizhi. Vá até lá e veja como estão as coisas.
target: This time, the lesson has moved to Boughrest Ridge. Go there and see how things stand.

source: Detritos de um constructo lumescama há muito destruído. Uma inspeção mais detalhada pode revelar algumas pistas ocultas.
target: Debris of a long-destroyed Lumiscale Construct. A closer inspection might reveal some hidden clues.

source: Deux statues de Kérasaures sont soudainement apparues dans la Plaine d'Os du Titan, suscitant la curiosité des habitants alentour. Nombreux sont ceux qui s'y sont rendus, espérant découvrir les secrets cachés…
target: Two Kerasaur statues have suddenly emerged on the Titanbone Expanse, stirring the curiosity of nearby residents. Many have come here, hoping to uncover the secrets that lie hidden...

source: Deuxième zone de déclenchement de la mission principale
target: Second trigger zone on Main Mission

source: Diario de la familia Fisalia I
Diario de la familia Fisalia II
Die Akademie experimentiert mit einer neuen Technologie, die angeblich in der Lage ist, mächtige Feinde zu simulieren, um das Kampftraining der Truppen zu verbessern ...
target: The Academy is experimenting with a new type of technology, rumored to be capable of simulating powerful enemies to help with the troops' combat training...

source: Die Apotheker hier geben den Einheimischen eine persönliche medizinische Beratung und geben Rezepte aus.
target: The pharmacists here give personalized medical advice and dispense prescriptions to the locals.

source: Die Apotheker hier geben den Einheimischen persönliche medizinische Beratung und geben Rezepte aus.
target: The pharmacists here give personalized medical advice and dispense prescriptions to the locals.

source: Die Einrichtung des Ordens, in der verbotene Bücher und Dokumente aufbewahrt werden. Bei der Invasion der Schwarzen Flut versank sie vollständig ins Nichts.
target: An institution where the Order sealed all forbidden books and records, now lost beneath the depths of the lake during the Dark Tide.

source:
Die Frequenz, die nach dem Kampf mit starken Feinden in der Welt zurückblieb und sich durch deine Erinnerung in die Form der Rote Spinnenlilie kristallisiert.
Auf der Bühne wartet die Sängerin des Jenseits auf dich.
target:
Lingering frequencies left by a fierce clash between two formidable forces, now shaped by your memories and taking the form of Lycrosis.
The singer from beyond still awaits on the stage.
